descriptor.name: Baden-Württemberg LGL ALKIS cadastral parcels
descriptor.scope: 78 valid, distinct official cadastral polygons verified in thirteen local 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged WUP settlement locator. Complete pages, forced three-row pagination, all 78 fresh native cadastral-reference reads, valid synthetic absence, footprint and source binding passed. Independent GEOS in EPSG:32632 found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry, overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Stuttgart parcels returned through the Baden-Württemberg LGL ALKIS service; nearby valid ground is verified, without requiring the settlement centroid itself to fall inside a parcel. Wider municipal completeness, legal boundary accuracy and long-term identifier continuity remain unverified.
descriptor.operator: Landesamt für Geoinformation und Landentwicklung Baden-Württemberg (LGL)
descriptor.licenceNote: Official LGL owner-free ALKIS parcel geometry; publisher conditions informational. Legal title, boundary survey accuracy and citywide completeness are unverified.
